Create your very own cursed tanks by mixing and matching modules and fight with other players!

THIS GAME IS NOT MEANT TO BE REALISTIC! THIS IS NOT WARTHUNDER!!!
Enjoy :D

scripts.title: Cursed Tank Simulator UmbraHub
scripts.features:
Discord Server for Update: https://discord.gg/9Z4UCaXXks

🛡️ Segmented ESP: Highlights Hulls and Turrets independently with different colors.

🎯 Critical Hit ESP: Highlights Crew members (Driver, Gunner, Loader) and Ammo Racks to land fatal shots.

🔴 Aim Tracers: Renders a laser beam from enemy barrels, allowing you to dodge incoming fire.

💥 God Gun & Secondary God Gun: One-shot every tank.

🔫 Enhanced Weapon Mods: Infinite Shell Speed, Perfect Accuracy, and Zero Bullet Gravity.

🎯 Silent Aimbot: Lock onto Ammo Racks, Crew, or Hull/Turret with adjustable smoothing, FOV circle, wall check, and movement prediction.

✈️ Fly Mode: Full tank flight with WASD/Space/Ctrl controls and adjustable speed (up to 750 studs/s).

🚫 Noclip: Phase through any obstacle, toggleable with a keybind.

☀️ Environment: Fullbright, No Fog, and Always Day toggles for optimal visibility.

⚙️ Settings: Fully customizable render distance (up to 5000 studs), team checks, color pickers, transparency sliders, hide system cursor, and more.
